title: Review: fix loop 5 — 8 commits across 7 files
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — The changes in this batch are cleanup fixes with no new user-facing surface area. The P1 risks are all narrow (error message metadata, reconnect behavior on slow SSE clients, pre-V6 database edge case). None require coordinated deployment or create API lock-in.
Confidence: 8% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) the draw_messages scroll arithmetic — I traced it manually but there is no test that exercises non-zero scroll_offset with exact pixel output; (2) the try_send behavior when close_after_first=true and the channel is exactly-full at the None send — the task breaks without sending the close-signal, but the stream terminates anyway via live_tx drop, which I verified by reading the take_while chain, but this depends on tokio::sync::mpsc behavior I did not test empirically; (3) the pre-V6 DB migration path — I read the schema code but did not trace V4's UPDATE execution path. Would raise confidence if: (a) a ui::tests case for draw_messages with scroll_offset>0 was added; (b) the pre-V6 data scenario was covered by a migration regression test.
